exam_scheme.note: Conducted annually by the Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE), Chaltlang, Aizawl, in accordance with the statutory provisions of Section 23(1) of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, and National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) norms. The test comprises two independent papers: Paper I for candidates intending to teach Primary Stage (Classes I to V) and Paper II for Elementary/Middle Stage (Classes VI to VIII). Each paper consists of 150 objective multiple choice questions (MCQs) carrying 1 mark each with no negative marking. The test duration is 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes) per paper. In Paper I, Language I is English and Language II is Mizo or Alternative English. In Paper II, candidates choose between Mathematics & Science or Social Studies for their 60-mark subject specialization. A minimum score of 55% or more qualifies candidates for the award of the MTET Certificate, which carries lifetime validity under amended NCTE guidelines.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official registration, attendance, and qualification statistics compiled directly from the published result notifications, gazettes, and statistical abstracts released by the Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE), Chaltlang, Aizawl.
